<?php
$x="old";$w="extra";$z="mid";$y="new";$n=0;
function ping(){echo "P;";}class SelectedY{public function __destruct(){global $w;$w="changed";echo "D;";throw new TypeError("destructor");}}
function &f():string{global $x,$w,$z,$y,$n;try{return $x;}finally{echo "O;";ping();try{return $w;}finally{echo "W;";ping();try{return $z;}finally{echo "M;";ping();try{return $y;}finally{++$n;echo "I",$n,";";ping();if($n===1){$y=new SelectedY;}else{$y="fixed";}}}}}}
try{$r=&f();echo "rnull=",(int)($r===null),";";$r="changed";}catch(TypeError $e){echo "R:",$e->getMessage(),";";}
echo "x=",$x,";w=",$w,";z=",$z,";n=",$n,";yfixed=",(int)($y==="fixed"),";";

try{$r=&f();echo "rnull=",(int)($r===null),";";$r="changed";}catch(TypeError $e){echo "R:",$e->getMessage(),";";}
echo "x=",$x,";w=",$w,";z=",$z,";n=",$n,";yfixed=",(int)($y==="fixed"),";";
